verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents an A/R aging report for customers and a set of general financial reports (Balance Sheet, P&L, Cash Flow), but nothing on accounts payable aging or vendor balances, let alone as of any point in time. Receivables evidence is a different story and does not transfer, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can see accounts payable aging and vendor balances at any point in time
